file_insights.changes: Refactored supplier list view to use apply_list_filters utility
key_modifications: Replaced manual queryset variable naming with 'queryset' for consistency
Converted inline search logic to FilterConfig structure
Replaced manual pagination with apply_list_filters utility call
Simplified context preparation by extracting values from result dictionary

patterns_discovered.description: Manual view logic for filtering, searching, and pagination replaced with centralized apply_list_filters utility
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces code duplication across views and ensures consistent filter behavior

patterns_discovered.description: Search parameters and field definitions moved to declarative FilterConfig objects
patterns_discovered.benefit: Makes filter definitions more readable and maintainable

patterns_discovered.description: apply_list_filters returns structured dict with 'page_obj', 'filter_values', and 'paginator'
patterns_discovered.benefit: Predictable context structure across all refactored views

patterns_discovered.description: Material count annotation maintained on queryset before passing to utility
patterns_discovered.benefit: Preserves view-specific business logic while leveraging generic utility

gotchas_discovered.description: Context values must be extracted from result dictionary structure (e.g., result['page_obj'], result['filter_values']['search']) rather than direct variables
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Template must be tested to ensure it receives expected context keys

gotchas_discovered.description: Changed from suppliers.count() to result['paginator'].count after refactoring
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Accessor pattern is consistent with Paginator API

gotchas_discovered.description: apply_list_filters requires default_ordering parameter; must match intended sort behavior
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Set to 'name' which aligns with supplier name display convention

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully refactored supplier_list view to leverage apply_list_filters utility, eliminating 12 lines of manual filter/pagination code

recommendations.recommendation: Verify template rendering with new context structure
recommendations.rationale: Context keys and value accessors have changed; template must access result['filter_values']['search'] instead of direct search variable

recommendations.recommendation: Test pagination and search functionality end-to-end
recommendations.rationale: Multiple changes to data flow; ensure page navigation and search filtering work correctly with new utility

recommendations.recommendation: Document FilterConfig usage pattern for consistency across codebase
recommendations.rationale: As more views are refactored, standardized filter definition pattern will improve developer onboarding
